name: npn-led-driver
prompt: Build a circuit where an Arduino Uno digital pin switches a 5 V LED through an NPN transistor used as a low-side switch, with a base resistor and a series resistor for the LED.
notes: The classic beginner driver stage. Low-side means the emitter sits on ground and the LED hangs from the 5 V rail into the collector; a correct board needs two resistors doing two different jobs.
